author: Trackster
quote:
1. Main character's  - Both the Jason and Lucia are very unlikeable there whole relationships for me ruin's the game Lucia is unlikable because she had a kid didn't tell Jason takes the kid to a café decides to rob a store at gun point and leaves the kid behind, goes to jail never tells CPS about Jason so he cant raise him, then my issue with Jason is dudes just cardboard his got zero personality all he does is grunt and say yes, sure, ok ect his a snooze fest, why should i care about these people? i care more about Cal than i do with the 2 main character's.

2. Story quests - they top loaded the game with these Chores, go buy flowers, fix up the house, collect clothes ect, i didn't mind doing them but they needed to be spread out just felt awful to actually do these things one after another in a GTA game its GTA not sims or SimCity

3. Gameplay - game play is decent there is alot too do but the issue and reason im giving it a low score is because again the MC im doing them as i have no reason to like the person im playing as just 2 wet noodles, but gameplay yes its ok if u ignore everything else diving is cool fishing is cool but not being able to steal a car down your own road in a GTA game naaa that ruined it for me, then there is the Stores 20 shoe stores in the game...... i didnt want too say it but here it comes, you can tell that a bunch of women made this game, Jason the male lead boring no personality, they didnt know how to make him interesting and then the quests buy her flowers ect yeah u can tell who wrote that as well, then when you play as lucia where my quests to help Jason feel good? no where to be seen because again Women wrote this game and it shows sadly, i have to say the educational parts like fixing up the house was cool, untill you realised everything jason did was wrong, you dont put drywall in bottom top, the sanding was incorrect and the roofing was bad as well no waterproofing layers just new tiles, sure its a game but they praised themselves over the ultra realism 

4. Overall statement TLDR: you can tell Women wrote this game, like i said before Jason is a wet towel of comedy and personality, game functions like a Sims / SimsCity game, feels more female focused then male focused but they admitted that so yeee
